title: Maria Watches Over Us 4th Season
native: マリア様がみてる 4thシーズン
synopsis:
Life for the young women at Lillian Girls’ Academy couldn’t be more exciting! The Yamayuri Council is working on a theater production with the all-boys Hanadera Academy, and the school festival is quickly approaching. But Yumi’s duties pale in comparison to the task assigned to her by Sachiko: choosing someone as a petite soeur! Will she be able to handle the pressure of such a monumental decision, or will Yumi crumble under the weight of the Council’s — and Sachiko’s — expectations?

(Source: Maiden Japan)

episodes.title: Shock at the School Festival
episodes.synopsis: Yumi and the Yamayurikai prepare a production (The Tale of Torikaebaya) for the upcoming school festival with neighboring boys school, Hanadera.

episodes.title: A Normal Day That Isn't Anything Special
episodes.synopsis: The day of the School Festival has arrived, there are many attractions but most importantly, the drama club is performing Little Women and Yamayurikai, The Tale of Torikaeba. With so much going on, the day might not just be another ordinary day.

episodes.title: Soeur Audition
episodes.synopsis: This year's remaining, petite soeur-less en boutons, Yoshino and Yumi are feeling the pressure to find their little sisters, for various reasons. Yoshino suggests that they have a Soeur Audition to do just the thing.

episodes.title: The Future Soeur
episodes.synopsis: The Kendo competition is just around the corner and Yoshino promised Eriko she would chose a petite soeur before then. Yoshino might have finally found a candidate, but her choice leads to its own complications.

episodes.title: The Red Rose's Sigh
episodes.synopsis: After exams are over, Yumi and Sachiko decide to go to the amusement park together. Much to Yumi's chagrin, Kashiwagi seems to have followed Sachiko to watch over her.

episodes.title: The Surprise Guest
episodes.synopsis: While Rei struggles to come to grips with Yoshino's choosing of a petite soeur, Yumi is deeply concerned for Toko after hearing that she ran away from home.

episodes.title: The Blank Map of the Future
episodes.synopsis: The Yamayuri Council holds a Christmas party! However, the merry festivities are overshadowed by Yumi's decision to ask Toko to be her petite soeur and Yoshino's introduction of Nana.

episodes.title: The Other Side of the Clouded Glass
episodes.synopsis: Yumi's still recoiling from the shock of Toko's rejection. To help get her mind off of things, Sachiko hosts a New Year's party at her home.

episodes.title: The Actress with the Fake Mask
episodes.synopsis: Yamayuri Council elections are occuring and while the positions typically go to the soeurs of those already in office, Toko decides to run as well. Could such an upset be possible?

episodes.title: Key Holder
episodes.synopsis: Yumi, Yoshino, and Shimako have secured their positions in the Yamayuri Council, but questions remain. Why did Toko enter if she planned on losing all along? Why doesn't Yumi try to talk to Toko?

episodes.title: The Heart's Keyhole
episodes.synopsis: Toko continues to further isolate herself from the Yamayuri Council while Yumi treats the issue calmly. Noriko, however, remains most concerned and attempts to bridge the rift that's been created.

episodes.title: Criss-Cross
episodes.synopsis: The Valentine's Day Treasure Hunt goes off without a hitch, and with Noriko's urging, Toko decides to participate. But as Toko searches for Yumi's card, she finds that she understands Yumi even less than she'd thought.

episodes.title: Searching For You
episodes.synopsis: The winners of the Valentine's Day event all go out on their respective dates, but most importantly, Yumi and Toko find what the future could hold in store for them.
